prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE finished portrait mobile game cover, exact 3:4 composition, edge-to-edge artwork, no mockup board, no device frame.
Primary request: make ONE BOMB PARTY cover for OPA, as a faithful sibling of the user's preferred existing NEVER HAVE I EVER cover, while giving Bomb Party a distinct silhouette and a simpler background.
Input image 1 is the DIRECT STYLE REFERENCE, NOT an edit target. Match its appealing rounded stylized cartoon character anatomy, warm peach skin, soft fabric texture, cozy warm light, plum/lavender/blue-violet shadows, and inviting expressive illustrated finish. Keep this reference's art direction. Do not invent a new illustration style or recreate the discarded generic three-people-in-a-purple-room compositions.
Scene: a close crop of a party-game object being passed between friends. Two stylized hands with sleeves from the recurring cast reach from opposite sides to pass ONE round matte charcoal cartoon bomb. One purple knit sleeve, one muted lavender sleeve. The bomb is the unmistakable hero shape, about 42% of canvas width, centered around 34% of canvas height. The receiving hand clearly opens beneath the bomb while the giving hand holds its side. Natural readable hand anatomy, one hand per side, five fingers per hand. A short curved fuse has one SMALL warm coral-orange glowing tip. The bomb remains playful and nonviolent, no explosion, no realistic weapon detailing.
Composition: NO full character faces and NO crowd. Crop naturally into wrists and forearms so the object and handoff gesture dominate. The upper half communicates the action instantly. Reserve a calm plum-colored negative-space field in the lower middle for the title. Only a softly suggested tabletop edge at the very bottom and one blurred warm lighting patch in the background; no room furniture details, no walls covered in objects, no neon signs, no posters, no popcorn, no mugs, no other cards, no confetti, no decorative icon swarm.
Palette: deep plum and soft dusty lavender environment, saturated blue-violet confined to gentle shadows, warm peach hands, restrained lime as ONE small sleeve detail, and coral red as the specific Bomb Party accent. Retain rich warm reference colors and soft finish; avoid making every surface electric purple. Smooth understated background with depth, not a flat solid field or a detailed environment.
Exact text: "BOMB" on the first line, "PARTY" on the second, ALL ENGLISH UPPERCASE (TT). Spell B O M B and P A R T Y exactly, no extra words. Both lines centered horizontally. Title block occupies roughly y=55% to y=73%, slightly below the center, with comfortable margins all around. Typeface: the reference's friendly rounded heavy lettering adapted to uppercase, consistent letter heights and spacing, crisp easy-to-read silhouettes and generous counters. Straight level baselines. BOMB warm cream #FAF5E8, PARTY soft vivid coral red #F46D72. A small subtle dark plum edge/shadow for contrast, minimal depth, no huge extruded 3D typography, no slanted/bouncing individual letters. Title never overlaps the bomb or hands.
Keep the image attractive and readable at 150-pixel thumbnail width. Strong hierarchy: round bomb and transfer gesture, then bold title, then quiet atmosphere. No brand logo, no watermark, no other text. Produce one portrait cover only.

review.composition: ერთი ბომბი და გადაცემის ორი ხელი; სახეების განმეორებული ჯგუფი აღარ დომინირებს.
review.background: რბილი იისფერი სიღრმე, სანათის ერთი ბუნდოვანი ლაქა და მაგიდის კიდე.
review.appIntegration: საცდელი ფაილია; მოქმედი ყდები და აპის კოდი უცვლელია ამ ეტაპზე.
